To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) classification approaches outperform regression approaches, (2) the use of synthetic data is beneficial, (3) the use of a deeper architecture is beneficial and (4) joint training of detection and viewpoint estimation tasks improves performance.

the most important factors for viewpoint estimation are: (i) the use of a deeper network, (ii) joint training with detection, (iii) classification over regression, (iv) synthetic data, and (v) a large training dataset.

(1) the best performance is achieved by a classification approach using a deep CNN trained on a large dataset of real images and a smaller dataset of synthetic images, and (2) a joint training of detection and viewpoint estimation improves the results by 2.5%.
